title: Class trainers and tier advancement, re-derived from the final client
purpose: Replaces the lost research/20260914-class-trainer specification (class-trainer-spec.json, rules R1.x-R5.1) that ClassAdvancement, ManifestationManager and CharacterManager cite. Every rule below names the client data it was decoded from, so ClassTrainerEvidenceTests can check the implementation against it.
research_dir: /home/blizz/backups/rasa-net/research/20260926-trainers-economy (the marker decoder and this file's generator in work/, TaRapedia revisions in wiki/, the archived official notes in web/, the navmesh probe output work/probe.out)

client.method: Static only: xdis 6.3.0 (vendored) unmarshals each .pyo; generated literal tables are read with research/20260926-mission-catalog/tools/decode_literal_table.py, uimapmarker.pyo with a stack interpreter over the trdis.py disassembly (research/20260926-segment3-audit/work/trdis.py), code modules by reading their disassembly. No client code was imported or executed. The TRAINER markers agree record for record with research/20260926-segment3-audit/work/trainer-map-markers.json.

rules.rule: Each class trains only into its immediate children.
sources: characterclass.pyo (constants RECRUIT=1 .. EXOBIOLOGIST=15)

gameuiutil.pyo g_ClassTree (built at code offsets 1425-1865; Soldier/Specialist under Recruit, Commando/Ranger under Soldier, Sapper/Biotechnician under Specialist, Grenadier/Guardian under Commando, Sniper/Spy under Ranger, Demolitionist/Engineer under Sapper, Medic/Exobiologist under Biotechnician)

rules.rule: The tier levels are 5, 15 and 30; a trainer is needed to advance there.
sources: uielementlanguage.pyo (5695,1): "If you've reached a tier level (5, 15, or 30), you'll want to visit a trainer to select a class advancement. Trainers are located in all major AFS-occupied bases and cities."
official class pages (docs/source-sweep-2026-09-13.md): Recruit 01, Soldier/Specialist 05, tier 3 15, tier 4 30

rules.rule: A class is held at the level before its tier level; experience keeps accruing.
sources: video 8VXeKzGUv0c B2 (the Recruit reaches 4, message 663 follows, the experience bar stays full; docs/character-progression-client-evidence.md 'Implementation, 2026-09-14')
playermessagelanguage.pyo (663,1): "You will not advance in level until you visit a trainer and choose a new character class to advance in."

rules.rule: Reaching the gate sends player message 663 once, then AvailableCharacterClasses.
sources: playermessagelanguage.pyo (663,1)
video 8VXeKzGUv0c B2 (order after the level-up line)

rules.rule: One clone credit is granted at the tier choice; the trainer window shows it before training.
sources: video 8VXeKzGUv0c B2 (trainer window shows one credit on the Recruit)
official Paul Sage guide, 2008-02-01 (a credit at each tier choice; docs/retail-accuracy.md)
TaRapedia 'Leveling Up' rev 36344 (2009-03-04): 'Just before the training you'll also recieve a Clone Credit'

rules.rule: The tier window closes when the player is dead or beyond MAX_MISSION_SHARE_RANGE (20) of the trainer.
sources: gameconstants.pyo MAX_MISSION_SHARE_RANGE = 20 (code offset 1950)
actor.pyo IsInMissionShareRange: body.InRadiusOf(other.body, MAX_MISSION_SHARE_RANGE)
tierselect.pyo Update, source lines 202-208: hides when avatar.IsDead() or not avatar.IsInMissionShareRange(actor)

rules.rule: The single trainer speaks the generic group: 337 can train, 339 nothing left to teach, 340 not ready yet.

value.337: Greetings Soldier! \r\n\r\nI'm here to train you, regardless of your specialty. Just don't forget to clone. If you clone now, you'll be able to explore a different path later; otherwise you'll be stuck forever with your decision.
value.339: You already know all I can teach you, soldier. Now get out there and put it to use!
value.340: You think you're ready for training? Well you're not - yet. Come back when you've got a little more action under your belt and we'll talk about training you in the ways of AFS.

sources: npctrainerdialoglanguage.pyo keys (337,1), (339,1), (340,1)

rules.rule: Training is offered as CONVO_TYPE_TRAINING (bCanTrain, dialogId); the client needs no npc package to converse or train.
sources: npc.pyo CanTrain (source lines 245-254): trainingInfo = convoDataDict.get(CONVO_TYPE_TRAINING); unpacks (bCanTrain, dialogId); returns bCanTrain
npc.pyo _GetUseAction (source lines 60-66): the CONVERSE action exists whenever convoStatus != CONVO_STATUS_NONE
npc.pyo Recv_NPCInfo only stores npcPackageId (used for objective dialogue, not training)

rules.rule: SelectNewCharacterClass(classId) names no trainer: the server checks a living player at the gate, near a trainer, choosing an immediate child.

CT-TREE

rules.rule: Cloning spends one credit of the source from character selection into an empty pod. The clone keeps class, level, experience, Logos, waypoints and hospitals and the missions its source completed; it starts with no active missions, no money, the starter gear, no clone credit, and its attribute and skill points unspent.
sources: client charactercreation.pyo OnCreateCharacter: RequestCloneCharacterToSlot(sourceSlot, destinationSlot, name, gender, height, appearanceData, raceId) (original)
official live notes 1.4, 2008-01-29 (research/20260926-reward-items/work/rgtr-patch-1.4-20080129.txt line 7): 'Cloning now resets your attribute points as well as your skill points.' (original)

official live notes 1.4, 2008-01-29 (same file, line 262): 'Wilderness, Crucible, Plateau and Abyss - Targets of Opportunity - Mission related and other non-repeatable objectives will now auto complete for cloned characters if they were already completed prior to cloning.' - a clone knows its source's completed missions (original, implicit)
official Wilderness walkthrough: 'Even future clones of your character have full use of the symbol.' (original; docs/source-sweep-2026-09-13.md 7.8)

TaRapedia 'Cloning' rev 16906 (2007-11-28): completed missions count as completed for the clone, which 'will have no active missions in the mission log'; no money and no weapons, level-1 armour (observed, pre-final)
TaRapedia 'Beginners Guide' rev 35313 (2008-10-23): 'You can't change / these will persist on the clone: Level and class, Logos symbols gained, Quests completed' (observed, final era)

rgtr.com player guide 'Your Clone and You' (Shaon94, captured 2007-12-11 to 2009-01-09, text unchanged): 'Items that ARE reset upon cloning are: Skills, Missions, Friends List (for now at least), Clan affiliation' - with 'Since missions are not carried over make sure to finish off any that you do not want to repeat', the mission log (observed; its 'Attributes' not reset predates the 1.4 notes and is superseded)
IGN Player_Compiled_Cloning_Tips (pre-1.6): cloning 'wipes the quest log' (observed, early 2008)
rules.unverified: friends and ignore lists (account-wide in the emulator; two early-2008 sources report them reset 'for now'), titles and clan membership (not copied; no final-era source), and the Targets of Opportunity auto-completion for clones, which waits for those missions (GAP-CLONE-SOCIAL-STATE, GAP-CLONE-TOO-AUTOCOMPLETE)
rules.reconciliation: The audit's conflict (completed missions kept, 2009 guide, vs quest log wiped, IGN) is not a conflict: every source that distinguishes the two says the mission log's open missions are lost and completed missions carry, and the official 1.4 notes build the clone's Targets of Opportunity credit on that. Implementation unchanged.

rules.rule: A clone brings no clone credit of its own. Made before its source reached the tier gate, it earns the gate's credit itself; made at or past the gate (experience already at the threshold, trained or not), it does not.
sources: TaRapedia 'Cloning' rev 16906 (2007-11-28): 'If you clone before this point, then your new clone will also earn a clone credit upon completing the tier. If you clone after completing the tier, even if you have not yet trained in a new class, your clone will not be awarded the additional clone credit.'
TaRapedia 'Clone Credit' rev 31080 (2008-06-03), Clone Credit Management tip 2
TaRapedia 'Beginners Guide' rev 35313 (2008-10-23): 'clone your character before receiving the clone credit from the the next tier choice (for example: cloning at level 14.9, not 14.99999)'
rules.implemented_by: CharacterManager.RequestCloneCharacterToSlot (clone_credits 0, experience copied) and ManifestationManager.ApplyLevelUps (credit only when experience crosses the threshold)

rules.rule: The clone enters the world where its source stood when it was cloned.
sources: rgtr.com player guide 'Your Clone and You' (captured 2007-12-11 to 2009-01-09, unchanged): not reset upon cloning: 'Location upon cloning. (aka if you clone in a hostile area that is where your naked clone is created upon logging in, So be careful.)'
rules.implemented_by: CharacterManager.RequestCloneCharacterToSlot (map, position and rotation of the source)
rules.unverified: no final-era footage of a clone's first login; the guide's text dates from 2007-12 and was republished unchanged through 2009-01

rules.rule: Right-clicking a Clone Credit item (class 26491, augmentations 6 item and 70 clonecredit) sends RequestUseCloneCredit(entityId) (method 706). The server spends one token and adds one clone credit, answered with CloneCredits(count) (704), on which the client shows PM 955 'Your cloning credits have increased.' and the Clone Credit tutorial.
sources: trpython/client/augmentations/clonecredit.pyo CloneCredit.InventoryUse line 19: gameclient.SendCallActorMethod('RequestUseCloneCredit', (self.entityId,)); GetRightClickOption: eTooltipRightClick_Use (original)
game/generated/client/methodid.pyo: CloneCredits 704, CloneCreditsChanged 705, RequestUseCloneCredit 706 (original)

trpython/client/augmentations/manifestation.pyo Recv_CloneCredits line 1672: a count above a known count posts PM_CLONE_CREDITS_ADDED and tutorial CLONE_CREDIT_ADDED, then UI_UPDATE_CLONE_CREDITS (original)
playermessagelanguage.pyo 955: 'Your cloning credits have increased.' (original)

TaRapedia 'Clone Credit' rev 31080 (2008-06-03), unchanged at rev 35135 (2008-10-16): 'Right-click on the clone credit token (it can be found in the last tab of your backpack) to enable a clone credit on your character.' (observed: the effect, one token for one credit)
rules.unverified: use from the footlocker or clan lockbox (the client's lockbox windows offer the same right-click when the backpack is closed; the server accepts only the backpack, OD-115, GAP-CLONE-TOKEN-LOCKBOX-USE); any refusal message (the client has none)

rules.rule: The character selection screen shows each pod's clone credits from CharacterInfo's CharacterData (index 8) and enables Clone only for an occupied pod with a free pod and more than zero credits.
sources: trpython/client/augmentations/characterselectionpod.pyo: kCharacterData_CloneCredits = 8; Recv_CharacterInfo stores characterData[8]; Recv_CloneCreditsChanged(cloneCredits) replaces it
trpython/client/ui/characterselectionwindow.pyo line 597: Stats.PlayStats.CloneCredits.SetText(u'%s' % cloneCredits); line 614: CloneBtn.Enable(not bIsEmpty and bIsAnyEmpty and cloneCredits > 0)
rules.implemented_by: CharacterData (index 8) and CharacterManager.RequestCloneCharacterToSlot (re-sends both pods' CharacterInfo after a clone)
rules.unverified: whether the live server refreshed the source pod with CloneCreditsChanged (705) or a new CharacterInfo; both set the same field

rules.rule: Since D12 (live 2008-09-18) each hub that had trainers has one single class trainer who trains every class; the per-class trainers are obsolete.
sources: official live notes 'Deployment 12.5: 9/18/2008' (playtr.com/news/patch_notes/deployment_125_9182008.html, Wayback 20081018170941; copy research/20260926-trainers-economy/web/): "Deployment 12 is on Live! It features a new version of the tier selection process ..." and, under UI, "The tier selection process has changed in several ways.  Individual trainers for each class have been replaced by one single trainer on maps that had trainers previously."

the same text on TaRapedia 'Updates/2008-09-18' (pageid 11400, rev 35871): "The tier selection process has changed in several ways. Individual trainers for each class have been replaced by one single trainer on maps that had trainers previously."

TaRapedia 'Updates/2008-08-14' and 'Updates/2008-08-15' (rev 35870, 32222): "Many unnecessary class trainers have been removed from all maps. Players should no longer find Tier 4 trainers in maps earlier than Mires, and should no longer find Tier 2 and 3 trainers after Mires."
npctrainerdialoglanguage.pyo (337,1): "I'm here to train you, regardless of your specialty."
